target.title: security(audit): warn on plugin load paths and SecretRef env fallback
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two operator visibility gaps in OpenClaw security posture checks:

1. **`plugins.load.paths` trust-boundary risk** — Operators can point `plugins.load.paths` at arbitrary local directories, but `openclaw security audit` did not evaluate those configured paths for filesystem risk (world-writable paths, missing entries, bundled aliases, synced folders) before runtime plugin load.
2. **SecretRef env fallback visibility** — Runtime secret resolution can fall back to environment variables in some configurations; operators lacked a dedicated audit finding when that fallback was active.

**Concrete example:** An operator adds a world-writable `/tmp/demo-plugin` to `plugins.load.paths` and configures gateway auth via SecretRef that silently resolves from `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`. Before this PR, `openclaw security audit` did not surface either risk explicitly.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `collectPluginLoadPathAuditFindings` and wires SecretRef env-fallback diagnostics into `openclaw security audit` / doctor health contributions so misconfiguration surfaces as explicit findings instead of silent trust expansion.

## User Impact

**Before:** Risky plugin load paths and active SecretRef env fallbacks could go unnoticed.

**After:** `openclaw security audit` emits `plugins.load_paths.*` and `GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRETREF_ENV_FALLBACK` findings operators can act on. No runtime behavior change unless operators remediate.

## Evidence

- `src/security/audit-plugin-load-paths.ts:55` — `collectPluginLoadPathFindings`
- `src/security/audit-secretref-env-fallback.ts` — maps shared diagnostics to audit findings
- `src/secrets/secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics.ts` — shared diagnostic collector
- Diff: +793 / −145 across audit, doctor, secrets, and docs

### Behavior proof

#### 1) Node runtime (production collectors, no Vitest)

```text
=== #100953 audit load paths + SecretRef proof ===
Node: v22.22.0

[world-writable load path]
  checkIds: plugins.load_paths.trust_boundary, plugins.load_paths.world_writable
  flags world-writable: true

[missing load path]
  checkIds: plugins.load_paths.trust_boundary, plugins.load_paths.missing
  flags missing: true

[SecretRef env fallback]
  codes: GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRETREF_ENV_FALLBACK
  flags gateway token fallback: true
```

#### 2) Call-site regression tests (real Vitest stdout)

```text
$ pnpm test src/security/audit-plugin-load-paths.test.ts src/security/audit-secretref-env-fallback.test.ts src/secrets/secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ security audit plugin load path findings > flags world-writable configured plugin load paths 94ms
 ✓ security audit plugin load path findings > flags missing configured plugin load paths 33ms
 ✓ security audit SecretRef env fallback findings > maps shared diagnostics to a security audit finding 1ms
 ✓ collectSecretRefEnvFallbackDiagnostics > flags gateway token SecretRef env fallback 22ms
 ✓ collectSecretRefEnvFallbackDiagnostics > includes runtime web-tool fallback warnings 0ms
 ✓ collectSecretRefEnvFallbackDiagnostics > skips gateway token fallback when auth mode is password 0ms
 ✓ collectSecretRefEnvFallbackDiagnostics > returns empty diagnostics when SecretRef resolves normally 0ms

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
   Duration  802ms

[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 5.41s
```

Regression flows:

| Collector | Steps | Expected finding |
|-----------|-------|------------------|
| `collectPluginLoadPathFindings` | `chmod 0777` temp dir with `openclaw.plugin.json` in `plugins.load.paths` | `plugins.load_paths.world_writable` |
| `collectPluginLoadPathFindings` | nonexistent path in `plugins.load.paths` | `plugins.load_paths.missing` (warn) |
| `collectSecretRefEnvFallbackDiagnostics` | gateway token `source: "env"` + `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` set | `GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRETREF_ENV_FALLBACK` at `gateway.auth.token` |

**Proof gap:** Full interactive `pnpm openclaw security audit` against a real operator `openclaw.json` was not captured here; Node + Vitest exercise the production audit collectors directly.
